## Triage verdict — "not started" confirmed at HEAD; gated on F13.4

**Verified fresh 2026-10-28:**
- No implementation exists yet: a code search for `kitty` across `pkgs/id` at HEAD returns exactly two files — `pkgs/id/TODO.md` and `pkgs/id/contract/shell-contract.v1.json` (the contract names the capability; nothing negotiates it). Neither `pkgs/id/src/world_ssh.rs` (no negotiation) nor `pkgs/id/examples/roc-world/Key.roc` (exists, 4,898 bytes, legacy-sequence parsing) has kitty handling — the issue's status section is accurate.
- **Prerequisite state:** the plan task #564 is CLOSED and F13.1 (#783) / F13.2 (#784) are CLOSED, but this item's named prerequisite — F13.4 presentation tiers, "detection precedes negotiation" — is its own issue, **#786, still OPEN**. The design source #535 (D1-053, input and presentation designs) is also still OPEN.

**Route:** no follow-up `small_fix` packet is enqueued. F13.5 is a size-M implementation item, not a small fix, and starting negotiation before F13.4's in-band detection lands would build it on the wrong layer. The Phase 13 sequence is intact and correctly ordered (F13.3 #785, F13.4 #786, this item, F13.6 #788, F13.7 #789, F13.8 #790 all open in order). Next trigger: #786 closing, at which point this issue is itself the scoped implementation packet — its acceptance criteria (terminal/web parity test, unambiguous Escape vs Alt, durable Input event unchanged) are already test-shaped.

### Summary
- #787 needs terminal/browser key-event parity, unambiguous Escape versus Alt, and the durable `Input` event unchanged.
- SSH raw input arrives in arbitrary chunks, so transport chunks cannot safely be parsed as complete keys.
- Recommend bounded per-connection framing before journal submission; negotiation replies must never become durable input.
- Add a richer Roc key API and browser encoder while retaining `Key.parse` and the legacy browser encoder.
- Negotiate only after F13.4 detection, with explicit opt-in to protect older compiled guests.
- Keep `Input(Vec<u8>)`, existing session frames, journal format and guest ABI unchanged.

**Design PR:** https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/3812

### Phased plan
A. Verify the profile and add shared fixtures plus additive Roc decoding. B. Add bounded, incremental input framing. C. Add an inert browser encoder. D. Establish cross-language parity against the actual Roc decoder. E. Integrate opt-in SSH negotiation/framing after F13.4. F. Activate browser opt-in and validate example compatibility. A–D can land independently; E/F depend on detection and the parity oracle.

### Questions for Drew
None. The issue makes the product choice; the note records reversible engineering defaults and leaves no decision that blocks implementation.
